_doc: Per-device corrections for gen.py (see its docstring). Keep each entry to what was read on the real device and say where.

msi-claw-8-ex._source: read live 2026-11-09 on a Claw 8 EX AI+ (Bazzite 45, kernel 7.2.15-ogc1.1.fc45, board MS-1T91, BIOS E1T91IMS.10E) with `godot --headless --path app -- --controls list`: InputPlumber + PowerStation + steamos-manager (no hhd), BAT1 with charge_control_end_threshold 0, ADP1 + two ucsi supplies

asus-rog-ally@steamos-3.10._source: read live 2026-11-09 on an original ROG Ally RC71L: SteamOS 3.10 (BUILD_ID 20260924.1000), kernel 7.2.4-valve1-1-neptune, BIOS RC71L.342, InputPlumber 0.78.0 managing 'ASUS ROG Ally' (profile Default, gamepad1 = deck-uhid), steamos-manager running, no PowerStation or hhd; BAT0 threshold 0 with MaxChargeLevel -1; FanControlState 0; empty AvailableGpuPowerProfiles; ally:rgb:joystick_rings 'rgb rgb rgb rgb' 0644; hwmon5 asus + hwmon6 asus_custom_fan_curve
